title: Is fashion a waste of money?
instructionsHu: Vitatkozz a vizsgáztatóval az alábbi állításról. A kiosztott álláspontod: az állítás ELLEN érvelsz – ezt az álláspontot a vita során nem változtathatod meg. Fejtsd ki az érveidet, reagálj a vizsgáztató ellenérveire, és próbáld meggyőzni őt.

debate.statement: Following fashion trends is a waste of time and money
candidateIdeas: Clothes are a way of expressing your personality and creativity.
Looking good can increase self-confidence, especially for teenagers.
Following fashion does not have to be expensive: second-hand shops and clothes swaps are popular.
Fashion is part of culture and reflects social change.
The fashion industry creates millions of jobs.
examinerArguments: Fast fashion is one of the most polluting industries in the world.
Trends change so quickly that clothes are out of date after a few months.
Teenagers feel pressure to buy brands, and those who can't afford them may be bullied.
Your personality is shown by what you do, not by what you wear.
The money could be spent on experiences, education or saving for the future.

followUpQuestions: But fast fashion is terrible for the environment. How can you defend that?
Don't you think young people feel too much pressure to wear expensive brands?
Isn't it better to spend money on travel or experiences than on clothes?
